newsitem.title: USA: Marquette Medical files for 2.75 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Marquette Medical files for 2.75 mln shrs.

text.p: Marquette Medical Systems Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2.75 million Class A common shares.

Of the total, one million shares Class A common are being offered for sale by the company and 1.75 million Class A are being offered by the selling shareholders. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 17,158,691 common.

The underwriters have been granted a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 412,500 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Dillon, Read & Co Inc, Bear, Stearns & Co Inc and Robert W. Baird & Co Inc.
Net proceeds will be used to reduce the company's long-term indebtedness, the filing said.
Marquette, based in Milwaukee, Wisc., is engaged in the development and manufacture of medical equipment and integrated systems for patient monitoring and diagnostic cardiology applications.
